description: This Kotlin interface defines API endpoints related to video likes, including retrieving likes, liking, and unliking a video, using retrofit2 annotations.

classes.name: VideoLikesApi
classes.description: Interface defining API interactions for video like functionalities such as getLikes, like, and unlike.

methods.name: getLikes
methods.description: Fetches the likes for a specific video by video ID.

methods.name: like
methods.description: Sends a request to like a particular video by ID.

methods.name: unlike
methods.description: Sends a request to remove the like from a specific video by ID.
